$comment: Labeled audio-trigger eval corpus (ADAAAA-7674, closing the AC1 exception from ADAAAA-7658). One entry per trigger class. A class with `clip: null` is an explicitly recorded gap and is reported as N/A — it is not a pass. Onsets are video-rail seconds; the match window used by the scorer is [-matchPre, +matchPost] around each onset. Clip files live on the box under the perceive /data volume (or docker/data); point --clip-root at them.

classes.labelSource: video-rail accepted GOAL timestamps for the clip (ADAAAA-4970 baseline corpus)

10 verified referee-whistle onsets across 7 distinct clips (the AC0 recall set), plus 4 `detectedOnsets` that were verified AFTER labelling (9c09c609 15.5 s, 09dccf1b 6.2 s, 02a5105d 8.3 s and 12.3 s) and therefore count as true positives for FP accounting only, never as recall. Every onset is verified independently of the detector by evals/verify_whistle_onsets.py at 16 kHz: the 2.4-3.4 kHz band rises over a 10 s ambient window while speech/low stay near ambient, the band is tonal (flatness <= 0.25) and its peak sits inside 2.4-3.4 kHz. Measured rise (whistle x / speech x / low x / peak Hz / flatness): 9c09c609 3.4 s = 7.2x/0.8x/1.0x/3090/0.044, 23.6 s = 9.8x/0.5x/0.5x/3160/0.026, 40.4 s = 35.1x/0.2x/0.0x/3130/0.019, 15.5 s = 8.5x/0.6x/0.5x/3150/0.048; 2939eff0 10.1 s = 25.3x/1.0x/0.0x/2480/0.065; 6f65bdbe 3.3 s = 35.9x/1.0x/0.0x/2490/0.053; 11b90ebf 7.4 s = 16.2x/0.4x/0.5x/2470/0.026; cf318d96 7.2 s = 13.6x/1.0x/0.1x/2830/0.031; 70257120 8.8 s = 28.1x/1.4x/1.8x/2620/0.130 and 10.8 s = 9.2x/2.4x/1.4x/2570/0.080; 910c9b68 1.4 s = 37.2x/0.6x/1.4x/2520/0.026; 09dccf1b 6.2 s = 10.1x/0.9x/2.7x/2510/0.039; 02a5105d 8.3 s = 6.2x/2.5x/0.4x/2490/0.012 and 12.3 s = 6.2x/1.3x/0.2x/2620/0.135. The clip's previously labelled 4.2 s onset was re-measured at 5.9x (+7.7 dB) over ambient and dropped: below the >= 6x verification bound, so it is not quotable as a verified onset. Duplicate footage in the corpus (same audio fingerprint) was collapsed, so the clips are distinct footage, not re-exports of one. The 27 negative windows are 4 s stretches verified free of a narrowband tonal burst; the original 30 included 3 windows that this run found to contain verified whistles (09dccf1b 6.2 s, 02a5105d 8.3 s / 12.3 s) and those were removed. Scored at 16000 Hz because that is the production PCM rate; the 8 kHz vs 16 kHz band-rise delta measured 0.0-0.3% on every onset (AC1).

classes.gapReason: no footage with a stadium PA announcement in the corpus: a 240-clip acoustic survey of the box clip corpus (docker/data/clips) plus the named real clips found speech-dominated stretches only in broadcaster voice-over, and PA speech is not acoustically separable from commentary without source metadata we do not have. Remains N/A; acquisition needs a clip with a known PA call (stadium feed / goal announcement).

no footage with a music bed: the harmonicity check (stable fundamental + integer harmonic stack) on the corpus' low-frequency-dominant stretches scored 0.25-0.38 harmonicity — the same as control stretches of the same clips — so those are stadium rumble, not music. Remains N/A until a clip with a broadcast intro bed is acquired.
